correctness.rationale: For K_{2,2,2}, reconstructed the graphic-matroid forest definition, purity and shellability, 48 pair-swap automorphisms, and rank-preserving barycentric flag orbit chains. Independent enumeration reproduces 12 edges, forest face vector (12,66,212,408,384), and full quotient flag-cell vector (38,441,1594,2148,960). Inspected verify.py enumerating all flags and exact integer differentials, checking d^2=0 and 2586 unit cancellations to chain ranks (1,0,0,3,5); the displayed 3x5 residual d4 matrix has determinantal divisors (2,4,8), hence Smith factors (2,2,2), H3=(Z/2)^3 and H4=Z^2. The forest complex has Euler 134 and is a wedge of 133 4-spheres. Fixed-point-generating pair flips and pair swaps in W, Armstrong, and H2=0 yield pi1=pi2=0. The independent run separately enumerated the full finite face/flag inventory; it did not reexecute the entire 2586-step integral reduction, which rests on inspected exact source and specified residual matrix.
